decision_conditions: The proposed new roof and outbuilding, would by virtue of their design, scale, siting, form, and visually jarring combination, give rise to an awkward, incongruous, bulky and overbearing form of over-development that would unbalance and detract from the character and would harmfully erode the character and appearance of the host dwelling at rear and front, and would be detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene in this location. Given this, the proposal is not well designed. Therefore, it is contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), to policies D3, D4, and D8 of the London Plan (2021), to policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), and to polices DMD6, DMD11, DMD12,  DMD13, DMD14, DMD37 and DMD38 of the Development Management Document (2014).

A sufficient Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) has not been submitted to demonstrate that the proposal is safe from flooding and will not increase flood risk elsewhere, this is contrary to the requirements set out in the NPPF (2024) and the adopted Development Plans. Therefore, the Local Planning Authority has not been provided with a suitable basis for assessment to be made of the flood risks arising from the proposed development. Additionally, the proposal has failed to demonstrate measures to promote and manage sustainable drainage across the site which inhibits the ability of the Local Planning Authority to fully assess whether the proposed development would result in an increase in flood risk on or off the site.  The proposals are thereby contrary to the advice contained within the NPPF (2024), Policies CP1 and CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010), SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021) and DMD 59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Development Management Document (2014).
description: Erection of new roof with dormer, front rooflights and erection of outbuilding.
